programs.title: Bananas in Pyjamas
programs.desc: Pedro the pig is off his food. The Bananas try all sorts of ways to cheer him up without success. Finally, Rat solves the problem by showing that pigs like company when they eat.

programs.title: Bing
programs.desc: Coco is teaching Bing and Sula how to skip. Sula starts to get quite good at it, but Bing finds it difficult and gets frustrated. Can Coco and Sula help Bing learn to skip?

programs.title: Fizzy And Suds
programs.desc: Fizzy and Suds explore a demolition site! They see workers use drills, sledgehammers, and big machines to tear down a house. Trucks clear the mess and some parts get reused!

programs.title: Peppa Pig
programs.desc: Grandpa Pig needs help when his boat sinks, so Granddad Dog gives them all a lift to Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard so that the boat can be fixed.

programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.desc: Today Tsehay is playing a princess in The Wiggles Pantomime but loses her voice. We discover Bok has found it and now sounds exactly like Tsehay, will Icky and Sukie, the voice specialists be able to help?

programs.title: Shaun the Sheep
programs.desc: Bitzer is left with a mountain of work when the farmer is rendered incapable. Enter the farmhand who is more interested in his mobile phone than getting the task done.
